title: Days to Cover and Stock Returns
one_line: Days-to-cover (short interest ÷ daily turnover) predicts lower stock returns far better than short interest alone: equal-weighted long-short 1.19%/month, Sharpe 1.3 (1988-2012), positive in 23 of 25 years, gross.

findings.statement: DTC long-short 1.19%/mo EW (0.67% VW) vs 0.71% for short ratio.
DTC subsumes the short-interest ratio after 2000.

why.pattern: Shorting cost/crowding measured relative to liquidity.

reported_results.headline: Days-to-cover (short interest ÷ daily turnover) predicts lower stock returns far better than short interest alone: equal-weighted long-short 1.19%/month, Sharpe 1.3 (1988-2012), positive in 23 of 25 years, gross.

data_fit: Single-stock study — not testable on our ES/NQ data.
